  1. City of Emporia and United Way Announce Next Phase of Homelessness Coordination

    The City of Emporia and United Way of the Flint Hills are partnering to continue community coordination related to homelessness and housing stability. Read on...

  1. 18th Avenue Maintenance (Road G/Americus Road to the west line of DeBauge Soccer Complex)

    Beginning Friday, September 11, 2026, Stormont Vail’s contractor will close 18th Avenue eastbound traffic, from Road G/Americus Road to the west edge of DeBauge Soccer Complex for street maintenance at their construction entrance on 18th Avenue. Read on...

  1. 2026 Street Rehabilitation Project – 24th Avenue (Prairie St to Lincoln St)

    Beginning Monday, August 31, 2026, the City of Emporia’s Contractor will begin asphalt paving on 24th Avenue from Prairie Street to Lincoln Street. Read on...
